modules.module_title: Perform pre-operational checks on combine harvester machine

pcs.pc_description: ensure fuel, engine oil, hydraulic oil, water and coolant level are above the prescribed level and replenish if required
examine the battery's condition to ensure that wiring harness is intact
check the air filters for correct position and cleanliness
check the tyres for the required level of air pressure
examine all belts and chains for wear and tear/ damage and the required level of slackness
check all the guards, nuts and bolts for correct position and the prescribed torque
check the headlights and indicators for correct functioning
test that steering and brakes are working as expected
check all the displays, gauges, indicators, meters on the dashboard and warning alarms
identify the signs of any wear and tear/ damage such as worn-out/ misaligned bearings, cracks in shoes and tyres, etc.
apply grease on all the bearings of the machine as per the lubrication schedule provided by the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM)
maintain the record of pre-operational checks

modules.module_title: Make adjustments to the combine harvester machine

pcs.pc_description: attach or detach extra kits or machine parts according to the crop to be harvested
adjust the height and backrest angle of the operator’s seat to ensure clear view of the field and comfortable seating
set the reversing mirrors for a clear view
adjust the cutter bar and thresher drum as per the manufacturer’s instructions

modules.module_title: Inspect the agriculture farmland and grain crop

pcs.pc_description: check the soil type and hardness of the field
assess surface levelling and ground clearance for smooth movement of combine harvester machine
check the type of grain crop and its readiness for harvesting
identify the appropriate adjustments required in the combine harvester machine to harvest the crop
set the concave gap, upper and lower sieve openings, blower fan speed and the position and Rotation Per Minute (RPM) of reel according to the crop conditions
operate combine harvester machine at the ground speed suitable to the crop and field conditions
harvest crop in a pattern to achieve machine efficiency and minimise grain-loss
check the cutter bar for choking caused by straw/ grain
examine harvested grain on a regular basis while harvesting to ensure quality output

modules.module_title: Apply safety standards during machine operations

pcs.pc_description: use the relevant Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) while operating the combine harvester machine
check that guards are in place before operating combine harvester machine
mount or dismount the combine harvester machine only when it is stationary
instruct the farmer and co-workers not to come near the operational combine harvester machine
operate combine harvester machine in a safe and controlled manner
maintain a safe distance from the moving parts of the machine and overhead electricity lines
follow guidelines from the manufacturer’s safety manual before manually handling the machine
use the recommended tools and equipment to make any adjustments to the combine harvester machine
use an access ladder, steps or standing platform during cleaning, maintenance and refuelling

pcs.pc_description: park the combine harvester machine on a flat surface
shut down the combine harvester machine as per the operator's manual instructions

modules.module_title: Carry out maintenance of various machine parts

pcs.pc_description: inspect the engine, cutting/ crop lifter/ feeder house components for malfunction/ wear and tear/ damage
check all nuts and bolts for the prescribed torque and locking
check that flat belts, v-belts and roller chains have the recommended level of tension and the fanbelt alignment and fuse change as required
check battery for the prescribed voltage and electrolyte level
apply grease or lubricant on the greasing points
replace the engine oil, hydraulic oil, coolant, oil filter, fuel filter, air cleaner as per the maintenance schedule
refill the battery with distilled water as per the requirement
discharge dirty fuel through the drain plug
repair, adjust or replace the worn-out/ malfunctioning/ damaged components as per the SOP
use the manufacturer-approved spare parts, tools and equipment
arrange for technical help from a certified mechanic for complex problems
maintain the record of repair and maintenance activities
schedule the next maintenance as per the maintenance schedule
segregate waste into different categories
dispose non-recyclable waste appropriately
deposit recyclable and reusable material at the identified location
Evaluate and apply techniques to minimize losses during combine operation
